provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Joins nouns that go together as a conventional set: a dish and its accompaniment, an outfit and its footwear (トーストに目玉焼き, 浴衣に下駄). Unlike や and とか it does not present the items as samples of a larger set, and it joins only nouns, never verbs or adjectives. It is common in menus, captions and set phrases (鬼に金棒).

examples.ruby: 朝[あさ]ごはんはトーストに目玉焼[めだまや]きが定番[ていばん]だ。
examples.english: Breakfast around here is toast with a fried egg, always.

examples.ruby: ビールに枝豆[えだまめ]があれば、それでいい。
examples.english: Give me a beer and some edamame and I'm happy.

examples.ruby: 浴衣[ゆかた]に下駄[げた]で夏祭[なつまつ]りへ向[む]かった。
examples.english: I headed off to the summer festival in a yukata and geta.
